title: Daily Life - Buying A New Mobile Phone

segments.en: Hello everyone and welcome to EnglishPod.
My name is Marco.
My name is Catherine and today we have an intermediate level lesson all about cell phones.
segments.zh: 我的名字是凯瑟琳，今天我们有一个关于手机的中级课程。

segments.en: That's right.
We're going to be buying a cell phone or also known as a mobile phone.
segments.zh: 我们将购买手机或称为手机。

segments.en: So before we jump into the dialogue, let's take a look at a specific type of phone on Vocabulary Preview.
segments.zh: 因此，在我们跳入对话之前，让我们先来看看词汇预览中的特定类型的手机。

segments.en: Vocabulary Preview.
Well, the name of this phone is kind of funny.
segments.zh: 嗯，这款手机的名字有点好笑。

segments.en: It's called a smartphone.
It's very popular these days.
Things like the Apple iPhone or the HTC Hero.
segments.zh: 苹果 iPhone 或 HTC Hero 之类的东西。

segments.en: These are examples of a smartphone.
segments.zh: 这些是智能手机的例子。

segments.en: That's right.
So basically a smartphone has additional functions more than just a normal mobile phone.
segments.zh: 因此，基本上智能手机的功能不仅仅是普通手机。

segments.en: For example, you can check your email on a smartphone.
segments.zh: 例如，您可以在智能手机上查看电子邮件。

segments.en: Yeah.
So the thing that makes a smartphone different from a normal mobile phone is that it's like a small computer.
segments.zh: 所以让智能手机与普通手机不同的是它就像一台小型电脑。

segments.en: You can do things like Marco said, send emails or take photos, edit photos, use applications, things like that from your phone.
segments.zh: 您可以做一些事情，例如 Marco 说的，发送电子邮件或拍照、编辑照片、使用应用程序等。

segments.en: Okay.
So we're going to be talking about smartphones.
segments.zh: 所以我们将谈论智能手机。

segments.en: So let's listen to the dialogue for the first time.
segments.zh: 所以让我们第一次听对话。

segments.en: Hello sir.
May I help you?
Yeah.
I accidentally dropped my phone in the toilet.
segments.zh: 我不小心把手机掉进了马桶。

segments.en: I see.
Well, you've come to the right place.
We have over 100 models of more than 20 leading mobile phone manufacturers.
segments.zh: 我们拥有超过 20 家领先的手机制造商的 100 多种型号。

segments.en: Sounds good.
I don't want it to be too expensive.
Maybe something mid-range.
We have this new HTC smartphone.
segments.zh: 我们有这款新的 HTC 智能手机。

segments.en: It comes with the Android OS so you can download applications.
segments.zh: 它带有 Android 操作系统，因此您可以下载应用程序。

segments.en: It also has a built-in camera, MP3 player and touchscreen.
segments.zh: 它还有一个内置的摄像头、MP3 播放器和触摸屏。

segments.en: It works on the 3G network so you have fast access to the internet wherever you are.
segments.zh: 它适用于 3G 网络，因此无论您身在何处，您都可以快速访问互联网。

segments.en: What about Wi-Fi?
Of course.
You can access the internet from any hotspot as well as from home.
segments.zh: 您可以从任何热点和家中访问互联网。

segments.en: One last thing.
Is it waterproof?
All right.
We're back.
Now, have you ever done this?
Have you ever dropped your phone in the water?
segments.zh: 你有没有把手机掉进水里？

segments.en: Have you ever damaged the phone like that?
segments.zh: 你有没有这样损坏过手机？

segments.en: Luckily, no.
Knock on wood.
But I have a good friend who dropped his in the toilet and had to buy a new one.
segments.zh: 但我有一个好朋友，他把他扔进了马桶，不得不买一个新的。

segments.en: Yeah.
So this is not made up.
It's actually more common than what people think.
segments.zh: 它实际上比人们想象的更常见。

segments.en: But we'll get to that in a bit.
segments.zh: 但我们稍后会谈到这一点。

segments.en: Why don't we take a look at five key words in Language Takeaway.
segments.zh: 我们为什么不看看语言外卖中的五个关键词。

segments.en: Language Takeaway.
This first word is very important because in this particular dialogue, we're talking about the HTC smartphone.
segments.zh: 第一个词非常重要，因为在这个特定的对话中，我们谈论的是 HTC 智能手机。

segments.en: This is a special kind of phone and it has an Android operating system or OS.
segments.zh: 这是一种特殊的手机，它有一个 Android 操作系统或操作系统。

segments.en: So Android is something that Google came up with and they have this operating system that they're giving away for free.
segments.zh: 所以Android是谷歌提出的，他们有这个他们免费赠送的操作系统。

segments.en: If you want to use it, you can use it.
segments.zh: 如果你想使用它，你可以使用它。

segments.en: You can make a whole new phone using this operating system.
segments.zh: 您可以使用此操作系统制作全新的手机。

segments.en: So the operating system like Windows or what's the Mac one called?
segments.zh: 那么像Windows这样的操作系统还是Mac One这样的操作系统？

segments.en: Tiger OS.
Tiger OS.
You have these Linux.
Linux.
Yeah.
Linux.
These are like the interface that allows you to use your computer and to interact with it and so they're different for different kinds of computers.
segments.zh: 这些就像允许您使用计算机并与之交互的界面，因此它们对于不同类型的计算机是不同的。

segments.en: The same is true of a smartphone.
Exactly.
So that's what we're looking at today.
segments.zh: 这就是我们今天所看到的。

segments.en: If you see this word Android, it's a proper noun and as Catherine mentioned, it's the name of the OS or operating system developed by Google.
segments.zh: 如果你看到这个词 android ，它是一个专有名词，正如 Catherine 所提到的，它是谷歌开发的操作系统或操作系统的名称。

segments.en: So we're taking a look at a smartphone that uses the Android OS.
segments.zh: 因此，我们将看看使用 Android 操作系统的智能手机。

segments.en: Alright.
Now this phone not only carried this operating system but also an MP3 player.
segments.zh: 现在这款手机不仅携带了这个操作系统，而且还配备了 MP3 播放器。

segments.en: That's right.
An MP3 player is a device that plays songs for you.
segments.zh: MP3 播放器是为您播放歌曲的设备。

segments.en: So songs can be stored as MP3s.
segments.zh: 所以歌曲可以存储为 MP3。

segments.en: A good example of an MP3 player is an iPod.
segments.zh: MP3 播放器的一个很好的例子是 iPod。

segments.en: An iPod.
Exactly.
Or and for many of you, you're listening to this podcast as an MP3 file through an MP3 player.
segments.zh: 或者对于你们中的许多人来说，您正在通过 MP3 播放器收听此播客作为 MP3 文件。

segments.en: So that's the name.
We usually say MP3.
Exactly.
And another feature of this special smartphone is that you can use it on the 3G network.
segments.zh: 这款特殊智能手机的另一个特点是您可以在 3G 网络上使用它。

segments.en: What is a 3G network, Marco?
Alright.
So a 3G network is a third generation network which allows more information to be sent.
segments.zh: 因此，3G 网络是允许发送更多信息的第三代网络。

segments.en: So not only can you send voice like a normal cell phone network, but now you can send pictures or you can download information like for example your email.
segments.zh: 因此，您不仅可以像普通手机网络一样发送语音，而且现在您可以发送图片或下载信息，例如您的电子邮件。

segments.en: So this is a new 3G network.
segments.zh: 所以这是一个新的3G网络。

segments.en: It allows you to send more information, more data.
segments.zh: 它允许您发送更多信息，更多数据。

segments.en: Exactly.
3G, third generation.
And in addition to this, our customer wants to know about Wi-Fi.
segments.zh: 除此之外，我们的客户还想了解 Wi-Fi。

segments.en: You hear this a lot when you go to a hotel or a restaurant.
segments.zh: 当您去酒店或餐厅时，您经常听到这一点。

segments.en: They say we have Wi-Fi access.
segments.zh: 他们说我们有 Wi-Fi 访问权限。

segments.en: And Wi-Fi stands for wireless fidelity.
So it's basically internet that has no wires.
segments.zh: 所以它基本上是没有电线的互联网。

segments.en: You don't need to connect your computer to anything.
segments.zh: 您不需要将计算机连接到任何东西。

segments.en: You just log on and use the internet.
segments.zh: 您只需登录并使用互联网。

segments.en: Alright.
So look out for that when you're in a cafe next time.
segments.zh: 所以下次你在咖啡馆时要注意这一点。

segments.en: Do they have Wi-Fi?
Usually there's a sign on the wall.
And finally, this customer wants to know is this great phone waterproof?
segments.zh: 最后，这位客户想知道这款出色的手机是否防水？

segments.en: What is waterproof?
Alright.
So if you have a watch for example and you can take this watch into a swimming pool or the ocean, it means it's waterproof.
segments.zh: 因此，例如，如果您有手表并且可以将这只手表带入游泳池或大海，则意味着它是防水的。

segments.en: So it resists water.
It won't get damaged if it gets wet.
segments.zh: 如果它被弄湿，它不会损坏。

segments.en: Great.
So I could say that I have a waterproof jacket.
segments.zh: 所以我可以说我有一件防水夹克。

segments.en: So that means that when I go in the rain, my clothes don't get wet because they don't go inside the fabric.
segments.zh: 所以这意味着当我下雨时，我的衣服不会被弄湿，因为它们不会进入织物内部。

segments.en: Right.
So there are many things waterproof as watches or waterproof cameras.
segments.zh: 所以有很多东西作为手表或防水相机。

segments.en: I've never really seen a waterproof mobile phone though.
segments.zh: 不过，我从未真正见过防水手机。

segments.en: That's a good invention maybe.
segments.zh: 这也许是一个很好的发明。

segments.en: That would be.
Alright.
So those are five key words for language takeaway.
segments.zh: 所以这些是语言外卖的五个关键词。

segments.zh: 因此，当我们使用领导这个词时，我们是在说它正在引领一个行业。

segments.en: That means the most important manufacturers in a kind of industry.
segments.zh: 这意味着一个行业中最重要的制造商。

It's one of the best.

segments.zh: 如果我们想改变名词，我们可以说是领先的汽车制造商。

segments.en: Exactly.
So in Japan, I wonder who the leading car manufacturer is.
segments.zh: 所以在日本，我想知道领先的汽车制造商是谁。

segments.en: Is it Toyota?
Toyota.

segments.zh: 我们也可以说关于服装。

segments.zh: 美国领先的服装制造商是，我不知道，也许是棉花？

segments.zh: 所以你可以使用许多其他名词。

segments.zh: 所以回到手机的功能之一，我们谈到了内置的摄像头。

segments.en: Now this structure is interesting.
Built in.

segments.zh: 好吧，我们可以说，当事物是其他事物的一部分时，它们是内置的。

segments.en: For example, a built in camera is a part of a phone.
segments.zh: 例如，内置摄像头是手机的一部分。
